content: Common FastAPI+SQLAlchemy async RLS pattern: a per-request dependency extracts tenant_id (from JWT or header), and at the start of each DB transaction runs SET LOCAL app.tenant_id = :tenant_id (via set_config with local=true) before any tenant-scoped queries, relying on Postgres RLS policies (USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id')::uuid)) as the enforcement backstop.
